panels.title: Punctuality by station (on time = < 6 min late)

targets.rawSql:
select station_name as "Station",
       sum(planned_stops) as "Planned stops",
       round(100.0 * sum(punctual_stops) / nullif(sum(stops_with_actuals), 0), 1) as "Punctuality %",
       round(100.0 * sum(cancelled_stops) / nullif(sum(planned_stops), 0), 1) as "Cancelled %",
       sum(delay_minutes_total) as "Delay minutes",
       round(100.0 * sum(stops_with_actuals) / nullif(sum(planned_stops) - sum(cancelled_stops), 0), 1) as "Coverage %"
from punctuality_station_hour
where $__timeFilter(hour_start)
group by station_name
order by 3 asc

select hour_start as time, station_name as metric, avg_delay_min as value
from punctuality_station_hour
where $__timeFilter(hour_start)
order by 1
